facts.fact: Al3omk reports the Interior Minister saying GIR-CT, an integrated system for local-government revenue run with the Treasury, has been generalised and lets revenue offices issue payment receipts and permits electronically when they collect.

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior with Tresorerie Generale du Royaume

facts.fact: Al3omk reports the Interior Minister saying taxpayers have been given access to an electronic platform to file declarations and pay local-government taxes, under decree 2.22.176 of 29 March 2022 and a joint circular of 28 December 2022.
facts.system: Local taxes electronic declaration and payment platform

MAR.note: The platform is for local-government taxes under the Interior Ministry and Treasury, not the tax authority's own system.
